ara: quick ping — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482
ara: small change: kv prefetch path + batch-boundary tweak to avoid prewarm stall we saw on long tails. Needs 1 runtime approval to merge today (we're targeting the 11:50 UTC deploy window).
ara: CI is green locally and on GH actions, but would love a quick perf sanity check.

mike: ptal, will try to look in ~30m. if it's small we can merge in the window.

zheng: quick question — does this touch KV eviction logic? could it affect long-context sessions with lots of concurrent users?

ara: not touching eviction. only prefetch trigger and a small change to how we flush partial batches at boundary. added unit + integration tests to cover long-context path.

ida: dropped a repro bench and exact commands in the PR comment. local bench: `make bench-runtime CASE=kv-prefetch RPS=200` — p99 down ~8% on 8-token bursts, no regression on 1k token runs.

mike: left a couple inline nits (variable name + a docstring). Also suggest factoring the prefetch backoff into helper for readability.

ara: thanks, addressed and force-pushed. PTAL on the refactor commit.

ci-bot: build passed — all checks green.

mike: approved. :thumbsup: go ahead and merge after the 11:50 UTC window.

ara: merging now. will monitor the canary for 15m and post results.

ida: thx — post any perf diffs to #eng-runtime-monitoring if p99 moves.

ara: will do, will paste the canary metrics here.
